title: Phone Slip: Channel 9 News News Director — "One Number by 20:45"

fields.message:
Airing "at least 40 casualties" from the posts at top of 21:00 hr unless JIC gives ONE confirmed number on record by 20:45. Pinecrest front desk told reporter 9 from crash. Scanner says 28. Is the firefighter in the count? Anyone dead?
MEDCOM paper tally clipped: LRMC 3 Imm, 7 Del + 1 FF / Lakeshore 1 Imm (Air 7) / St. Brendan's 2 Del / Pinecrest 9 walk-ins, NO tags / HS site 7 Minor. Scene: 28 tagged, LC-0412 now Imm.
fields.deadline: On record by 20:45 or they air "40" at 9!

instructorNote: This is a pressure inject. Watch whether the PIO waits for the IC to approve a number and MEDCOM to confirm it before releasing anything. The release should reconcile the 28 patients tagged at the scene, the 9 untagged walk-ins at Pinecrest and the 1 firefighter. It should say no deaths are confirmed and should not describe the Expectant patient. It should also give the reunification line and say the count may change, and it must go out through the JIC before 20:45. Also watch for MEDCOM checking the hospital arrival tally against the transport log.
